agents.name: Regime filter (200D / 50D, structure)
agents.summary: BTC is transition regime: price above the 200D (73,144) and below the 50D (81,918); 50 above 200 (golden regime). 4H structure: range.
agents.learned: 200D MA is the simplest regime filter that historically avoided BTC bear markets; the golden/death cross lags (most of the move comes before the cross, and it failed to signal sustained rallies in 2021, 2023, 2024, 2025 and Sept 2026). Use it to set bias and size, never as an entry.
agents.rule: Bull = price > 50D and > 200D; bear = below both; transition otherwise. Trade only with the regime or at half size against it.

agents.name: Macro and liquidity regime
agents.hunt: FRED, CME FedWatch, DefiLlama stablecoins, Farside ETF flows
agents.summary: stablecoin supply -2.29% over 30d (7d -1.35%); BTC dominance 59.8%. Fed is in a hiking cycle (first hike since 2023 on 16 Sept 2026; most officials see another by year-end). FOMC days in 2026 were mostly bearish for BTC.
agents.learned: Global M2 overlays broke in 2025-26 (level correlation 0.94 but change correlation ~0.04). The real-yield and dollar channel plus ETF flows and stablecoin growth are the liquidity gauges that still work. Trade the surprise vs pricing on prints, never the decision itself.
agents.rule: Risk-on when stablecoin supply grows >0.5%/30d AND BTC in bull regime; risk-off when supply stalls AND bear regime. No leveraged positions through CPI/FOMC unless the trade is the event.

agents.summary: 1 symbols sit within 1% of the 4H 21 EMA with 9 > 21 (bull) or 9 < 21 (bear) and the daily regime agreeing.
agents.learned: Short-horizon MA/momentum rules are the only TA family with snooping-adjusted evidence in crypto, and that edge decays over time; intraday variants mostly fail after fees. The pullback entry works because it trades with the regime filter.
agents.rule: Price within 1% of 4H 21 EMA, 9 EMA on the trend side, daily regime agrees, 4H structure not against. Stop 1 ATR, target 2R.

agents.name: Sentiment contrarian (Fear & Greed)
agents.summary: Fear & Greed 30 (Fear); yesterday 30, a week ago 51, a month ago 72.
agents.learned: Contrarian F&G strategies beat buy-and-hold in academic tests, but a 1%-per-day scaling backtest gave only a modest edge because extremes persist for months; 'sell the greed' is more robust than 'buy the fear'. A 20+ point swing in 7 days happens on ~10% of days; the index flips in a day and mean-reverts over 2-3 weeks.
agents.rule: Buy zone <= 20, sell zone >= 80, scale 1%/day; otherwise informational. Treat as a 1-3 day signal.

agents.name: Cross-sectional momentum (long leaders / short laggards)
agents.summary: 30-day leaders: AIN, BEAMX, EVAA, MAGMA, PARTI. Laggards: AVAX, SUI, PUMP, SOPH, AKE. Rebalance weekly.
agents.learned: Liu-Tsyvinski-Wu: gross weekly long-short momentum returns of 2.5-4.1% (2014-2018), stronger in large caps; Man Group finds trend-following works best with 10-15 liquid coins and ~0.6 pairwise correlation limits diversification. Shorting illiquid names is the practical constraint.
agents.rule: Rank 30-day return across the universe; long top 5, short bottom 5, equal risk, rebalance weekly; stop 2 ATR.

agents.rule: Breadth = share of universe beating BTC over 30d: <40% BTC season, 40-70% rotation starting, >70% alt season.

agents.rule: Act only when 3+ independent smart wallets with 6+ month records agree AND a chart trigger exists; size for a fixed small loss.
